top_signals.title: Taylor Farms Pulls Products Over Salmonella Concerns
top_signals.summary: Bloomberg's Jessica Nix discusses the recent surge in foodborne illness outbreaks, attributing the increase partly to climate change and staffing shortages at the CDC and FDA. She explains that a salmonella outbreak was linked to jalapenos sourced from a farm in Mexico, prompting Coast Citrus Distributors to recall their jalapenos. She speaks on "Bloomberg Open Interest." (Source: Bloomberg)
